metadata.description: Three production-grade design skills (impeccable, design-taste-frontend, emil-design-eng) stacked into one composable Claude Code plugin, plus a fourth (houdini) for the cold-start blank canvas.

plugins.name: presto
plugins.description: Design plugin. /magic runs the full 8-phase flow with three modes (--surprise, default, --guided). /houdini fills the blank canvas with a real starter template. Six standalone break-out commands as first-class primitives.
